dialogues.jp:
卒業式の帰り道。桜舞う校庭を歩きながら、俺
は気の抜けた溜息を長く長く吐いた。
dialogues.en:
On the way back from the graduation ceremony, as I walked
through the sakura-laden campus, my sighs echoed loud and
true.
dialogues.text:
On the way back from the graduation ceremony, as I walked
through the sakura-laden campus, my sighs echoed loud and
true.

dialogues.jp:
学園内は未だ卒業パーティーで大いに盛り上がっ
ている。
dialogues.en: The graduation party at the school had barely begun.
dialogues.text: The graduation party at the school had barely begun.

dialogues.jp:
俺はそんな喧騒をよそに、ひとり校門のそばま
で来ていた。
dialogues.en:
I never liked all that hustle and bustle, so I headed for
the school gates.
dialogues.text:
I never liked all that hustle and bustle, so I headed for
the school gates.

dialogues.jp:
折角のイベントの日に早く帰ろうという学生は
俺くらいのものらしく、あたりに人影はほぼ見
当たらない。
dialogues.en:
Apparently I was the only one who scorned this much-awaited
event. Not a single soul was around me as I walked out.
dialogues.text:
Apparently I was the only one who scorned this much-awaited
event. Not a single soul was around me as I walked out.

dialogues.jp: （ふぅ………………隣が寂しいぜ…………）
dialogues.en: "(Boo.... sorta lonely...)"
dialogues.text: "(Boo.... sorta lonely...)"

dialogues.jp:
舞い落ちる桜花に世の無常を感じつつ、しみじ
み想う。
dialogues.en:
Just like the falling sakura petals, uncertain of where they
would land, I was filled with the same feelings.
dialogues.text:
Just like the falling sakura petals, uncertain of where they
would land, I was filled with the same feelings.

dialogues.jp:
……卒パがにぎやかであればある程、独り身の
切なさを身に染みて感じるな。
dialogues.en:
...Being the only one not participating in the graduation
party really was discouraging.
dialogues.text:
...Being the only one not participating in the graduation
party really was discouraging.

dialogues.jp:
意外に華やかな環境であったにも関わらず、今
日この日俺の隣に女の子の姿は――無い。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to all the situations that occured, there isn't any
girl by my side as I walked.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to all the situations that occured, there isn't any
girl by my side as I walked.

dialogues.jp:
（もっと日頃から積極的になれば、少しは状況
　も違ったかな……）
dialogues.en:
"(Maybe if I was more proactive those days, the situation
would be different now...)"
dialogues.text:
"(Maybe if I was more proactive those days, the situation
would be different now...)"

dialogues.jp:
などと思ったところで、すべては後の祭りだっ
た。
dialogues.en: My thoughts wandered to those enjoying the festival.
dialogues.text: My thoughts wandered to those enjoying the festival.

dialogues.jp: 俺の周りにいた女の子たち……。
dialogues.en: The girls around me...
dialogues.text: The girls around me...

dialogues.jp:
音夢や美春たち風紀委員は己の責務を真面目に
まっとうしているはずだ。
dialogues.en:
Nemu and Miharu would, of course, be seriously fulfilling
their disciplinary committee duties.
dialogues.text:
Nemu and Miharu would, of course, be seriously fulfilling
their disciplinary committee duties.

dialogues.jp:
ことりや眞子たちはこの後も片付けに忙しいだ
ろうし……萌先輩はちゃんと眠らずにいられた
んだろうか？
dialogues.en:
Kotori and Mako would probably be helping clean up after...
Moe-senpai would just fall asleep.
dialogues.text:
Kotori and Mako would probably be helping clean up after...
Moe-senpai would just fall asleep.

dialogues.jp:
さくらは……そういえば、見かけなかったな。
ま、あいつのことだからうたまると何処ぞへし
けこんでいるのかもしれない。
dialogues.en:
Sakura... now that I think about it, I didn't see her at all
there. Well, she's impossible to pin down to one place
anyway.
dialogues.text:
Sakura... now that I think about it, I didn't see her at all
there. Well, she's impossible to pin down to one place
anyway.

dialogues.jp:
本当に、俺ももうちょっと平素から女の子と仲
良くしていれば、卒業式の日にこんな侘びしい
想いに浸らずとも済んだのだろうか……。
dialogues.en:
Really, knowing so many fine young women so well, any other
person wouldn't be in this situation on graduation day...
dialogues.text:
Really, knowing so many fine young women so well, any other
person wouldn't be in this situation on graduation day...

dialogues.jp: 「……ま、いいか」
dialogues.en: "...Well, whatever."
dialogues.text: "...Well, whatever."

dialogues.jp:
人は人、俺は俺だ。こんな状態も『一匹狼』と
形容すれば格好がつく。物は考えようだよな。
dialogues.en:
Others are others, and I am myself. I'd just assume the
"lone wolf" motif, and won't think about it.
dialogues.text:
Others are others, and I am myself. I'd just assume the
"lone wolf" motif, and won't think about it.

dialogues.jp:
……うん。そうだそうだ。過ぎたことをいくら
思い返しても何の意味も無い。
dialogues.en:
...That's right. No reason to think about it any further if
it can't be solved.
dialogues.text:
...That's right. No reason to think about it any further if
it can't be solved.

dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、もう帰るのか？」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, are you heading home already?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura, are you heading home already?"

dialogues.jp: そんな俺に背中から声がかけられた。
dialogues.en: A voice echoed out from behind me.
dialogues.text: A voice echoed out from behind me.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ……工藤、お前一人なのか？」
dialogues.en: "Huh... Kudou, you're alone as well?"
dialogues.text: "Huh... Kudou, you're alone as well?"

dialogues.jp:
そこには、俺と同じく卒業証書の筒を手にした
工藤が立っている。
dialogues.en:
I turned around to see Kudou, holding his graduation
certificate tube like myself.
dialogues.text:
I turned around to see Kudou, holding his graduation
certificate tube like myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、そうだけど」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, pretty much."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, pretty much."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ふ〜ん、意外だな」
dialogues.en: "Hm, that's surprising."
dialogues.text: "Hm, that's surprising."

dialogues.jp:
工藤は普段から婦女子に人気のある、さわやか
美形青年だ。
dialogues.en:
Kudou's always been popular with the girls, and he's as
close to a bishounen as you can get.
dialogues.text:
Kudou's always been popular with the girls, and he's as
close to a bishounen as you can get.

dialogues.jp:
今日みたいな特別イベントの日は、それこそ引っ
張りだこ状態なのかと思ったのだが……。
dialogues.en:
Considering today's supposed to be a special event, I
would've figured that something special would've happened...
dialogues.text:
Considering today's supposed to be a special event, I
would've figured that something special would've happened...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「なんか、女の子から校舎裏に来てくれとかい
　う手紙が何通か来てたんだけど……断って来
　ちまった」
dialogues.en:
"Well, a girl brought me to the back of the school to
confess with a letter... but I turned her down."
dialogues.text:
"Well, a girl brought me to the back of the school to
confess with a letter... but I turned her down."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……もう、いいよ」
dialogues.en: "...That's enough."
dialogues.text: "...That's enough."

dialogues.jp: 聞いた俺が馬鹿だった。
dialogues.en: Of course.
dialogues.text: Of course.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……ん？　なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "...Hm? What's wrong?"
dialogues.text: "...Hm? What's wrong?"

dialogues.jp: 黙り込んだ俺を不思議そうに見つめる工藤。
dialogues.en: Kudou gave me a strange look for my "say no more" attitude.
dialogues.text: Kudou gave me a strange look for my "say no more" attitude.

dialogues.jp:
「それは俺に対する、さり気ない当てつけかね、
　工藤君」
dialogues.en:
"Are you trying to underline the difference between us,
Kudou-kun?"
dialogues.text:
"Are you trying to underline the difference between us,
Kudou-kun?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「え？　いや、そんなのとは違うって」
dialogues.en: "Eh? N, no, that wasn't what I was trying to say..."
dialogues.text: "Eh? N, no, that wasn't what I was trying to say..."

dialogues.jp:
工藤は俺の言葉に、困ったようにはたはたと手
を扇がせる。
dialogues.en: He covered his mouth in slight embarassment.
dialogues.text: He covered his mouth in slight embarassment.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「俺、女の子と付き合う気はないからさ」
dialogues.en: "I'm just not searching for a girlfriend right now."
dialogues.text: "I'm just not searching for a girlfriend right now."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……この贅沢者」
dialogues.en: "...At least you have the luxury of choice, eh."
dialogues.text: "...At least you have the luxury of choice, eh."

dialogues.jp:
俺は正直な気持ちでうめいた。顔のいい奴とい
うものは皆こんなにも贅沢なのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
I said plainly what I thought. This guy, when he does
actually start to search for a girlfriend, will have the
pick of the litter.
dialogues.text:
I said plainly what I thought. This guy, when he does
actually start to search for a girlfriend, will have the
pick of the litter.

dialogues.jp: （……いかんいかん）
dialogues.en: "(...Bah, what am I thinking.)"
dialogues.text: "(...Bah, what am I thinking.)"

dialogues.jp:
自分の頬を叩いて叱咤を加える。馬鹿だな俺、
つい今しがた決めたところじゃないか。人は人
だって。
dialogues.en:
I slapped my cheek with my hand. I shouldn't be stupid,
that's not decided yet... people are people, after all.
dialogues.text:
I slapped my cheek with my hand. I shouldn't be stupid,
that's not decided yet... people are people, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「……３年間……お互い、よく頑張って来られ
　たよな」
dialogues.en: "...3 years... we worked hard to get here."
dialogues.text: "...3 years... we worked hard to get here."

dialogues.jp: なにやら妙に感慨深げにつぶやく工藤。
dialogues.en: His words was filled with thoughtful emotion.
dialogues.text: His words was filled with thoughtful emotion.

dialogues.jp:
「なに言ってんだ。休みが明けたらどうせまた
　ここに通うことになるんじゃないか」
dialogues.en:
"What're you trying to say? After the break, we'd still be
walking this way to school again."
dialogues.text:
"What're you trying to say? After the break, we'd still be
walking this way to school again."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「そりゃそうだけど……たく、ムードのない奴
　だな」
dialogues.en:
"That's true, but... pah, you're horrible at reading the
atmosphere."
dialogues.text:
"That's true, but... pah, you're horrible at reading the
atmosphere."

dialogues.jp: 口を尖らせて俺を横目で｛にら／睨｝む。
dialogues.en: He glared at me from the corner of his eye.
dialogues.text: He glared at me from the corner of his eye.

dialogues.jp:
「野郎二人の場面でムードなんか出してどーす
　るんだ」
dialogues.en: "This isn't the mood that two idiots should be in."
dialogues.text: "This isn't the mood that two idiots should be in."

dialogues.jp: 俺は大きく｛あくび／欠伸｝をした。
dialogues.en: I stretched back and released a big yawn.
dialogues.text: I stretched back and released a big yawn.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ほんと、お前は変わらないよな」
dialogues.en: "You'd really never change."
dialogues.text: "You'd really never change."

dialogues.jp:
そんな俺を苦笑しつつ眺めていた工藤は、やが
てぽつりと呟いた。
dialogues.en:
He muttered those words, gazing at my laid-back demeanour
with a wry smile.
dialogues.text:
He muttered those words, gazing at my laid-back demeanour
with a wry smile.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……でも、そういうのって｛うらや／羨｝ましいな」
dialogues.en: "...But that's something I've always envied about you."
dialogues.text: "...But that's something I've always envied about you."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　なにが？」
dialogues.en: "Huh? What?"
dialogues.text: "Huh? What?"

dialogues.jp: 欠伸でにじんだ涙をこすりながら振り返る。
dialogues.en:
I turned my head to face him, wiping the tears from my eyes
from the yawn.
dialogues.text:
I turned my head to face him, wiping the tears from my eyes
from the yawn.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「どんなに環境が変わっても同じでいられるの
　がさ。それって、『自分』をしっかり持って
　るってことだろ？　羨ましいよ」
dialogues.en:
"No matter the situation, always being the same. You have a
firm grasp of what makes you, you. That's what I'm envious
of."
dialogues.text:
"No matter the situation, always being the same. You have a
firm grasp of what makes you, you. That's what I'm envious
of."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「羨ましい……俺が、か？」
dialogues.en: "...That's... something to be envious about?"
dialogues.text: "...That's... something to be envious about?"

dialogues.jp:
……そんなこと言われたのは初めてだ。まして、
自分をしっかり持ってるだなんて、これっぽっ
ちも自覚はない。
dialogues.en:
...That's the first time someone's said that to me. It's not
like I was conciously trying to be myself...
dialogues.text:
...That's the first time someone's said that to me. It's not
like I was conciously trying to be myself...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……俺も頑張ってみるよ。朝倉を見習ってな」
dialogues.en: "...I'd work hard, and try to follow your example."
dialogues.text: "...I'd work hard, and try to follow your example."

dialogues.jp:
そう言って工藤はなにが可笑しいのかクスクス
と笑い声をたてた。
dialogues.en: He laughed as he said that, somewhat out of place.
dialogues.text: He laughed as he said that, somewhat out of place.

dialogues.jp: 「……お前って、変な奴だなぁ」
dialogues.en: "...You're a weird one."
dialogues.text: "...You're a weird one."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「お前や杉並の友人をやってる時点で、その自
　覚は充分にあるよ」
dialogues.en:
"Given that I'm a friend of you and Suginami, that's to be
expected."
dialogues.text:
"Given that I'm a friend of you and Suginami, that's to be
expected."

dialogues.jp: にっと笑いながら俺の鼻先に指をつきつける。
dialogues.en: He grinned, poking my nose.
dialogues.text: He grinned, poking my nose.

dialogues.jp: 「お、言うなこいつ」
dialogues.en: "Ohh, big talk now."
dialogues.text: "Ohh, big talk now."

dialogues.jp:
俺も笑い返しながら工藤の背中を拳でぐりぐり
と押した。
dialogues.en: I laughed and puched Kudou int he back a few times.
dialogues.text: I laughed and puched Kudou int he back a few times.

dialogues.jp:
コイツとはそれ程親しく付き合ってたわけじゃ
ないけど、顔に似合わず意外と面白い奴かもな。
dialogues.en:
From these years of knowing him, I've come to realize that
he's far more interesting than just a pretty face.
dialogues.text:
From these years of knowing him, I've come to realize that
he's far more interesting than just a pretty face.

dialogues.jp:
新しい学期が始まったら、もうちょっと仲良く
してみてもいいかな……。
dialogues.en:
When the new school year starts, I should try to get a bit
closer to him...
dialogues.text:
When the new school year starts, I should try to get a bit
closer to him...

dialogues.jp:
そうだ、俺にはまだまだ未来がある。本校に進
めば新しい出会いがいくらでも待ってるかもし
れないじゃないか。
dialogues.en:
That's right, I still have my future before me. Who knows
what encounters I'd have that will shape my future in the
main school.
dialogues.text:
That's right, I still have my future before me. Who knows
what encounters I'd have that will shape my future in the
main school.

dialogues.jp: 「…………ぅおし！　やる気出てきた！」
dialogues.en: ".....Alright! I'm pumped now!"
dialogues.text: ".....Alright! I'm pumped now!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「っと……びっくりした、何だよ」
dialogues.en: "Wha...? You scared me there, geez. What is it?"
dialogues.text: "Wha...? You scared me there, geez. What is it?"

dialogues.jp:
急に声をあげる俺を、目を丸くして見つめる工
藤。
dialogues.en:
He rolled his eyes as my voice unexpectedly rose several
notches.
dialogues.text:
He rolled his eyes as my voice unexpectedly rose several
notches.

dialogues.jp: 「いや、こっちのこと」
dialogues.en: "Nothing, nevermind."
dialogues.text: "Nothing, nevermind."

dialogues.jp: 俺はかるく笑いながら首を振って見せた。
dialogues.en: I smiled and stretched a little.
dialogues.text: I smiled and stretched a little.

dialogues.jp: 「……そういや、お前も帰るんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "...Anyway, are you heading back as well?"
dialogues.text: "...Anyway, are you heading back as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「まぁな。一緒に遊ぶ相手もいないし」
dialogues.en: "I guess so. I don't have a companion for the party."
dialogues.text: "I guess so. I don't have a companion for the party."

dialogues.jp: 詰まらなそうに答える工藤。
dialogues.en: A brief, almost curt response from him.
dialogues.text: A brief, almost curt response from him.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ俺と卒業パーティー見て廻らないか？」
dialogues.en: "Want to look around the graduation party with me, then?"
dialogues.text: "Want to look around the graduation party with me, then?"

dialogues.jp:
本当は家に戻って寝てしまうつもりだったが、
折角出てきたやる気を無駄にするのも勿体無い
話だ。
dialogues.en:
If I went home now, I'd just fall asleep. I don't want to
waste my good mood now that I've finally got it back.
dialogues.text:
If I went home now, I'd just fall asleep. I don't want to
waste my good mood now that I've finally got it back.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……朝倉とか？」
dialogues.en: "...With you?"
dialogues.text: "...With you?"

dialogues.jp:
工藤はしばし意外そうな顔をしていたが――割
に嫌そうでもなく頷き返した。
dialogues.en:
His face changed from one of surprise, to one of
appreciative thoughtfulness.
dialogues.text:
His face changed from one of surprise, to one of
appreciative thoughtfulness.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「そうだな。年に一度のことだし」
dialogues.en: "Why not? It'd be good once in awhile."
dialogues.text: "Why not? It'd be good once in awhile."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「よし、まずは屋台巡り！　目指すは全制覇だ！
　行くぞ！」
dialogues.en:
"Good! First target, the food stores! The goal is complete
consumption! Let's go!"
dialogues.text:
"Good! First target, the food stores! The goal is complete
consumption! Let's go!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「わわっ……ちょっと待てって」
dialogues.en: "Whawha... wait a sec!"
dialogues.text: "Whawha... wait a sec!"

dialogues.jp:
有無を言わさず腕をとり、校舎へ向けて歩き始
める。
dialogues.en:
Barely even waiting for his answer, I grabbed his hand and
started walking back to school.
dialogues.text:
Barely even waiting for his answer, I grabbed his hand and
started walking back to school.

dialogues.jp:
これまでのことを思い返してウダウダ言っても
始まらない。
dialogues.en:
Just sitting here and whining long-windedly, nothing will
come from that.
dialogues.text:
Just sitting here and whining long-windedly, nothing will
come from that.

dialogues.jp: 明るい未来を信じて、今はただ進むのみだ。
dialogues.en: I'd move ahead, believing in the bright future!
dialogues.text: I'd move ahead, believing in the bright future!

dialogues.jp: ◆ＥＤ・明日に向かって◆
dialogues.en: ◆ED. Towards Tomorrow◆
dialogues.text: ◆ED. Towards Tomorrow◆

dialogues.jp: 今日は卒パだが、寂しいことにひとり身な俺。
dialogues.en: Today was the graduation party, and I was left alone.
dialogues.text: Today was the graduation party, and I was left alone.

dialogues.jp: もう帰ろうかと歩き始めたとき、工藤と出会う。
dialogues.en:
Just as I was starting to walk back home, I bumped into
Kudou.
dialogues.text:
Just as I was starting to walk back home, I bumped into
Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
二人で色々話すうちに、前向きな気持ちになっ
た俺は、取りあえず工藤と二人で卒パを回るこ
とにしたのだった。
dialogues.en:
After talking about lots of things, I regained my
positivity, and convinced Kudou to look around the
graduation party together.
dialogues.text:
After talking about lots of things, I regained my
positivity, and convinced Kudou to look around the
graduation party together.

dialogues.jp: 明るい未来を信じて、今は進むのみだ！
dialogues.en: I'd move ahead, believing in the bright future!
dialogues.text: I'd move ahead, believing in the bright future!
